en:
First, we need an aphid, and if you didn't know, they hatch from eggs!
Press {0} to open your inventory, and click on one of the eggs to hold it.
Now with it in your hands, press {1} to drop it, [wave]use the same key to pick them back aswell![/wave] .
es:
¡Bienvenido al Complejo! Empieza eclosionando tu primer Áfido.
Presiona {0} para abrir el inventario, clickea en un item para sacarlo, y presiona {1} para dejarlo en el suelo.
¡Este ultimo tambien se usa para recoger!

en:
[color=coral]Tip:[/color] Press {0} as shortcut for grabbing the first item in your bag.
It is also the [shake]only[/shake] way to store an item back.

Aphids have needs that you have to take care of, such as [color=coral]food[/color], [color=cyan]water[/color] and [color=mediumpurple]affection[/color].
You can see how good they are doing by pressing {0} near them.
This will show you their current status and skill progress. 
You can start by petting them with {1}. This will also raise their bondship with you,
which affects some parts of their behaviour!
[color=coral]Tip:[/color] You can also use the same bind to interact with other things in the world.

You can purchase various items at the shop, such as food, toys, or eggs to hatch.
To buy them, you will need berries, which you get from aphids!
Aphids will generate berries every few minutes, you just need to manually harvest it by interacting with the aphid.
[color=coral]Tip:[/color] You can sell items in your inventory by pressing the [img width=50]res://sprites/ui/gui_icons/icon_sell.png[/img] symbol and clicking on any item you want to sell.
Food is more than just the single item. Near the shop a kitchen awaits, here you can mix and match ingredients to create all sorts of different recipes.

All dishes have different nutritional values and some even grant a skill bonus!
Keep in mind that your aphids will have a unique preference for certain types of food which grant them an even bigger bonus on all stats.
[color=coral]Tip:[/color] If you need to experiment, there's some berry bushes around that should help you do it for free...

You can watch all aphids that are, [wave]and[/wave] were under your care in the generations album.
Press {0} to open it, here you can see your aphids origins, and, if you have a deep bond with them, you can even see their current personality!

This is also the place where photos are displayed, click on either the [img]res://sprites/ui/gui_icons/icon_camera.png[/img] icon on the top right to see an aphid's album, or the one at the bottom left to see the general album.
By pressing {0}, you will activate free camera mode, where you can move freely through the resort.

[color=coral]First[/color] is the build menu, where you can place and move the furniture in the resort.
[color=coral]Second[/color] is the furniture shop, where you can purchase said furniture.
[color=coral]Third[/color] features the camera functions, such as aphid tracking and spectating.

You can send aphids to help requesta all over Bugaria! Simply head to the lobby and look in the job board to the left.
All jobs have a difficulty that dictates the amount of skills and levels needed to give it a chance.
After it is finished, you will be rewarded with berries and a small boost in skills.
Beware! Underleveled aphids have the chance to fail the request, gaining only half the berries.
Need a more efficient, faster push in skill leveling? Try training!

Certain furniture items allow to train specific skills, according to their description.
After placing it down, simply hold an aphid, and then interact with the building to start.
Progress is saved automatically when leaving!
es: El juego se guarda automaticamente al salir!
